race.description: Ladbrokes Turn On Flex Multi Mdn Plate
race.comment: VICTORIOUS DREAM (8) resumes with first-time blinkers off a recent Balnarring trial win, having battled home in heavy going on debut at Seymour. He was well in the market there and looks a sharp improver. ANGLING ANGEL (9) is the exposed threat after hitting the line strongly for second at Sale, much better there on turf after struggling on synthetic fresh. Stays at 1400m which is a slight knock but has the class. SILVER LIGHTNING (3) has been building into the campaign, placed at Cranbourne last start after racing wide. Up in trip should be okay now and he has claims. DISSIDENT WOODS (6) is now with the Freedman yard and could be an improver second time around.
